en.topic_title: Nepal flood death toll rises to 1,357 as rescuers scour tunnels
en.topic_summary:
The death toll from Nepal’s devastating flood rose on Tuesday to 1,357, with 5,326 people still missing, the country’s disaster authority said nearly two weeks after the August 26 disaster.



People look to recover their belongings in the aftermath of flash floods at Devighat in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 8, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP.
